name: The resistance of an ideal ammeter and an ideal voltmeter should respectively be:
description:
Question:

The resistance of an ideal ammeter and an ideal voltmeter should respectively be:

(a) Zero and Infinite
(b) Infinite and Zero
(c) Zero and Zero
(d) Infinite and Infinite

Answer: (a) Zero and Infinite ✅

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IDEAL AMMETER

Resistance = 0 Ω

Why?

Ammeter current measure karta hai.
Isliye ise Series mein lagaya jata hai.

Agar resistance zyada hua to current kam ho jayega.

Isliye Ideal Ammeter ka Resistance = 0 Ω

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IDEAL VOLTMETER

Resistance = ∞ (Infinite)

Why?

Voltmeter potential difference measure karta hai.
Ise Parallel mein lagaya jata hai.

Agar resistance kam hua to current khinch lega.

Isliye Ideal Voltmeter ka Resistance = Infinite

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TRICK

Ammeter → Series → Zero Resistance

Voltmeter → Parallel → Infinite Resistance

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MEMORY TRICK

"Ammeter Aaya Series Mein,
Resistance Ho Zero.

Voltmeter Baitha Parallel Mein,
Resistance Ho Hero (∞)."

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IMPORTANT FORMULAS

Ohm's Law

V = IR

Current

I = V/R

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

EXAM FAVORITE MCQs

Ammeter is connected → Series

Voltmeter is connected → Parallel

Ideal Ammeter Resistance → 0 Ω

Ideal Voltmeter Resistance → ∞

Ideal Ammeter Current → Maximum

Ideal Voltmeter Current → Zero

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Voltmeter → Parallel → Infinite Ω
